description: This file implements the logic for managing and automating Discord presence updates based on profile status, configuration, and connection state. It includes functions for configuration resolution, activity building, presence decision-making, and controller creation.

classes.name: PresenceGateway
classes.description: Interface representing the connection status and presence update method for Discord.

classes.name: DiscordAutoPresenceState
classes.description: Type representing the possible states of auto presence: healthy, degraded, exhausted.

classes.name: ResolvedDiscordAutoPresenceConfig
classes.description: Type for the resolved configuration of auto presence, including enabled status and text options.

classes.name: DiscordAutoPresenceDecision
classes.description: Type representing the decision outcome for auto presence, including state, reason, and presence data.

classes.name: DiscordAutoPresenceController
classes.description: Type for the controller object managing auto presence, with start, stop, refresh, runNow methods, and enabled flag.

methods.name: normalizeOptionalText
methods.description: Normalizes optional text input, trimming whitespace and returning undefined if empty or not a string.

methods.name: clampPositiveInt
methods.description: Clamps a number to a positive integer with fallback and minimum value constraints.

methods.name: resolveAutoPresenceConfig
methods.description: Resolves and validates the auto presence configuration, applying defaults and normalization.

methods.name: buildCustomStatusActivity
methods.description: Builds an Activity object for custom status with specified text.

methods.name: renderTemplate
methods.description: Renders a template string by replacing placeholders with provided variables.

methods.name: isExhaustedUnavailableReason
methods.description: Checks if a given failure reason indicates exhaustion (rate limit, overloaded, etc.).

methods.name: formatUnavailableReason
methods.description: Formats a failure reason into a human-readable string.

methods.name: resolveAuthAvailability
methods.description: Determines the current authentication profile availability state and reason.

methods.name: resolvePresenceActivities
methods.description: Generates presence activities based on current state, config, and reasons.

methods.name: resolvePresenceStatus
methods.description: Maps the auto presence state to Discord presence status string.

methods.name: resolveDiscordAutoPresenceDecision
methods.description: Main function to decide the auto presence state and generate presence data based on config, auth, and connection.

methods.name: stablePresenceSignature
methods.description: Creates a stable string signature of presence data for change detection.

methods.name: createDiscordAutoPresenceController
methods.description: Creates a controller object to manage auto presence updates, with start, stop, refresh, runNow methods.
